title: Assistant
memoryTitle: What the assistant remembers about you
memoryHint: The assistant stores your preferences and context here (markdown). Edit or clear the text — next time it gets exactly this.
memoryEmpty: Nothing yet. Tell it for example: "Remember that I write short e-mails."
emptyHint: I can see your projects, idea buffer and rules. Changes happen only after you confirm them.
chips: What is on my plate today?
questionsIntro: Questions to clarify ({{count}}) – pick an answer or write your own:
errorGeneric: The assistant did not respond. Please try again.
errorRate: You have used up the hourly AI cap. Try again in a while.
errorTimeout: The reply is taking too long. Please try again.
chipZasekl: I am stuck, let us do it together
poradaOffer: Shall we do the morning briefing?
poradaOfferHint: I will go through what is where, suggest where to start, and ask a few click questions.
memoryProjectsEmpty: None yet. Say for example: "Remember for the project that Petr decides."
errorLost: The previous conversation no longer exists on the server (it was deleted). Continuing in a new one — older messages are not here.
shrink: Shrink so the map is visible (keep typing)
imageAdd: Add an image or a PDF
imageHint: You can also paste an image or a PDF with Ctrl+V or drop it here
imageError: The image could not be loaded.
imageDrop: Drop the image or PDF here
imageDropped: The image is no longer stored, only the transcript remains.
imageOnly: Only an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP) or a PDF can be added.

pdf.title: PDF
pdf.hint: Merge several PDFs, split by pages, extract or remove pages. Everything happens in your browser – the file never leaves your computer.
pdf.dropHint: or drop them here (several at once)
pdf.rangeHint: Split with nothing entered = every page separately. Extract and remove need the pages entered.
pdf.fixHint: The assistant reads the page text and proposes corrections (a price, a name, a sentence). The file stays with you; the assistant only gets the text.
pdf.doneMerge: Done – {{count}} files merged, the file is downloading.
pdf.doneMerge_few: Done – {{count}} files merged, the file is downloading.
pdf.doneSplit: Done – {{count}} files are downloading (the browser may ask for permission once).
pdf.doneSplit_few: Done – {{count}} files are downloading (the browser may ask for permission once).
pdf.doneExtract: Done – the extracted pages are downloading as a new file.
pdf.doneRemove: Done – the file without the removed pages is downloading.
pdf.privacy: PDFs are processed only in your browser. Only the page text goes to the assistant, and only when you ask for a correction.

chyba.sifrovano: The PDF is password-protected or editing is restricted – it cannot be corrected.
chyba.poskozeno: The PDF could not be opened (damaged file?).
chyba.bezTextu: The PDF contains no text (probably a scan) – only PDFs with a text layer can be corrected.
chyba.textNecitelny: The PDF text cannot be read (font without character mapping) – it cannot be corrected.
chyba.mocVelke: The PDF is too large (30 MB at most).
chyba.nenalezeno: text not found on that page
chyba.nevejdeSe: the new text does not fit the space even when shrunk
chyba.jinySoubor: This is a different file (different page count) – choose the one the correction belongs to.

pdf.needFile: The file "{{name}}" is no longer loaded in the browser (the page was reloaded). Choose it again; the correction runs on your computer.
pdf.overlayNote: The correction is an overlay: new text in a built-in font over the original; the original text stays in the file (search still finds it).
pdf.textDropped: The PDF text is no longer stored in full (only the beginning remains).
pdf.includesEarlier_one: The file also contains 1 correction confirmed earlier in this conversation.
pdf.includesEarlier_few: The file also contains {{count}} corrections confirmed earlier in this conversation.
pdf.includesEarlier_other: The file also contains {{count}} corrections confirmed earlier in this conversation.
